notes: Small quality-of-life fix from a real session: when a Photo Lab paint on the fal engine fails and a RunPod endpoint is configured, the failure message now says the likely cause and the way out in place — a locked or out-of-credit fal account (the TOP_UP error) means switching the ENGINE chip to Your GPU, which is where the LoRAs live and where 18+ chat photos run anyway — instead of leaving that translation to a trip through the Troubleshooting logs.
